Why can a recessive phenotype reappear in the F2 generation?

courseDataChecksItem.prompt: Why can a recessive phenotype reappear in the F2 generation?
courseDataChecksItem.answer: Each heterozygous parent can contribute the recessive allele
courseDataChecksItem.explanation: Two recessive contributions can form a homozygous recessive offspring.
courseDataChecksItem.cue: Trace the normal mechanism before choosing an answer.
options: The recessive allele is always recreated by mutation
Dominant alleles vanish after one generation
Each heterozygous parent can contribute the recessive allele
Gametes carry both parental alleles together at every locus
